name: Far West Mirage
original_name: ファーウェストミラージュ
source:
Just once, if I could share with you a day that makes my soul tremble.

In the resplendent western jewel, the Loulan Empire,
you, one of the twin princesses, are about to wed a chancellor you do not love.

On the day of the grand ceremony that will grant you "everything", 
as the entire nation looks on.

A dazzling love story, unlike any the world has ever seen, begins to unfold.
